item.title: etcd Setup
item.description: This walkthrough uses an external etcd v3.6.14 server with a persistent Docker volume. PMS writes policies and ADS watches the same key prefix. The single-node example listens on loopback and uses plain HTTP for local development. Production TLS and cluster configuration follow the walkthrough. 1. Build Speedle Prepare Bash, Git, curl, Docker and Go 1.26.10 or Go 1.27.3. Start Docker, then build the native services: git clone --depth 1 https://github.
